https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/

notes.title: What awaits you in the third chapter of the Anvil Saga and more
notes.content:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

We're nearing the full release of Anvil Saga, and, in the meantime, we want to tell you about all of the features you can expect in the highly-anticipated update.

There will be new content, from the continuation of the story's finale to a wide range of changes in the previously released chapters. There will be two new quests waiting for you, which will further affect the story. In order to play through them, you'll need to start the game again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/91ac23361b03cbfc233dc59a5cc1fe7dcd476e47.png[/img]

During the third chapter of the game, Arthur will face harsh new challenges, such as a  terrible disease that has swept across the province. And the final battle will influence whether England, France, or the Bandits will prevail.

The length of the plague, the lives of several heroes, and the outcome of the final battle will directly depend on your decisions. Choose carefully – the fate of the province depends on you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/a28d685a65abcddd83b7ac38aebc57298235b503.png[/img]

In the Anvil Saga finale, Arthur and Jean-Jacques will face off in a blacksmith's duel within the imposing walls of the Baron's castle. You'll need to fulfill visitor's orders to decide the outcome of this epic tale.

We have created six different endings for Arthur and Jean-Jacques, and you will learn the fate of the Baron,the  faction heads, Finley, Olivia, Vlad, and even the Headman! Your actions will affect their fate, determining whether they will live happy lives or not. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/3bbdf7449117248fbf20770090abd66d5737e9a3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/ae2727d07d858d558257c95ac559d37503dfd8e4.png[/img]

This update will also contain the wood carving mechanic. Arthur will have to master not only the skills of a carpenter but also a carver.  Life in the Middle Ages was hard and you needed a lot of skills to survive.

The full release update for Anvil Saga will include:
[list]
[*] More than 10 hours of exciting gameplay;
[*] More than 30 complex customers with special needs and outlandish orders;
[*] Around 90 regular customers visiting the forge every day looking for a solution to their everyday problems;
[*] Story characters who can become either friend or foe of Arthur;
[*] 25 modifiers that affect gameplay and your business tactics;
[*] Plenty of quests and side-quests;
[*] Oddball apprentices with their own peculiarities, including funny and not so funny buffs and debuffs for them;
[*] 4 the stall levels and lots of decor for the forge of your dreams;
[*] A variety of end game options. 
[/list]
Thank you for supporting our small team throughout the development of Anvil Saga. Sharing your impressions, suggesting ideas, and helping us to find bugs has been an absolute joy. 

If Anvil Sags is not in your Steam library yet, it's time to add it there!

See you soon in a small, still French, province behind the anvil and furnace. 

Regards,
Anvil Saga Team

notes.title: The new Anvil Saga update is available now!
notes.content:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

We are releasing a new update with a number of important changes and bug fixes for Anvil Saga.

First of all, Arthur can no longer obtain the "Pacifist" trait. This has been requested by the warlike players since the game was first released – if you're one of them, let us know in the comments below.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_2fb0c47fc3fe45a081e9fb27223a94a1~mv2.gif[/img]

The order feed's priority list has been changed. Now there can be only one order with a certain priority, instead of several. For example, only a single order with a priority of "1", "2", "3", etc. We also added the ability to drag and drop order cards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/c8015ce1a84cc8f08fced9eac4a574305389e7d2.png[/img]

Improved the mechanics of equipping workers. Each blacksmith has a pool of three items and will automatically switch between them for the most efficient work completion on a particular machine. The equipment interface has also been redesigned specifically for this mechanic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/7af97ab1ad23db1c58ec89daed76d3435a238351.png[/img]

The workers' remuneration was overhauled to appear in a separate window, similar to the tax payment system. A worker's mood will decrease if you refuse to pay them.

A worker's speed will be directly influenced by their mood; characters who are not a part of the plot will leave the forge if they are in a terrible mood. You will need to keep an eye on your budget to ensure that the forge doesn't go bankrupt.

There are also small improvements to the visuals and sound design, such as animated birds appearing in the background and sound effects when changing the appearance of a room.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_c72019ed476b461bba0273fa9f9631a6~mv2.gif[/img]

In addition to the major interface changes, we have also added several small improvements: 
[list]
[*] The store will alert you if you do not have enough space for food or resources.
[*] The amount of food will appear when you hover your cursor over a cupboard.
[*] Wood has been moved to a separate category in the store. 
[*] Items from Antonio's shop have been added to the order feed. 
[/list]
Fixed bugs:
[list]
[*] Bug with Oscar's tutorial.
[*] Bug with displaying Olivia's order for tools.
[*] Bug with the debuff of bandits.
[*] Bug with gaining experience from sharpening on the sharpening stone.
[*] Bug with bandits taking away Arthur's winnings after the first fair.
[*] Bug with chronologically incorrect arrival of Arthur the impostor in the sandbox. 
[*] Bug with Vlad coming to the forge several times a day. Now he can only come to the forge once a day. 
[*] Bug where customers who had already placed an order left when the counter closed.
[/list] 

Other than that: 
[list]
[*] Revamped the prestige system. Every 5 points of prestige, the cost of orders is increased by 1% up to a total cost of 150%. 
[*] Increased the speed of spawning customers by 30%. Also, if a monk is spawned, with a probability of 70% the game will spawn a witch, and vice versa.
[*] Added the ability for the player to accept story orders that require wood, even if the player does not have a workbench. 
[*] Increased the capacity of log racks. 
[*] Fixed prices for logs. 
[*] Fixed the conditions for building the bottom left room in the mine.
[*] Added new achievements!
[/list]
Thank you to everyone for supporting Anvil Saga! Please share your impressions of the game here or in our [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url]. We read all of the feedback and constantly try to improve the game for you.

Regards,
Anvil Saga Team

notes.title: Meet the Anvil Saga team!
notes.content:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

New Year's Eve is upon us! While you're getting ready to celebrate with your family and friends, we decided to introduce you to the Anvil Saga team. In this post, we'll share what each one of us handles on the project, why we love Anvil Saga, and what inspires us to forge a game about being a blacksmith.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/28eb0e8dcca463b0d60f61bcccd9a768affdb547.png[/img]

[h3][b]Timur, the author and programmer at Anvil Saga.[/b][/h3]

I've always liked games and wanted to create one of my own. I started to get interested in gaming at the age of 13 – it all started with learning Game Maker. After about a year, I switched to Unity and a year after that, my first project, Life is Hard, was available on Steam.

I've been developing almost every day since then, and it's safe to say that it's my hobby and favorite thing to do – it's not a job. Also, I've always loved history, and Anvil Saga, as a game in a historical setting, is perfect for me.

I love watching other people play Anvil Saga. Seeing tens of thousands of people play your project is an indescribable feeling. Since I'm the only programmer on the team, there were – and still are – quite a few challenges. But I see the project getting better and better each month, and that inspires me to work more.

I wish all players more awesome games and more spare time to play them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/e3ea7f574458e5b024dcee7c62286b6bbe6b42ea.png[/img]

[h3][b]Evgeny, creative alias Pixel_Poem, pixel art artist and animator. [/b][/h3]

I've been working on Arthur's adventures for about two years now, and I'm responsible for all the visuals in the game. Before Anvil Saga, I spent several years working on Police Stories and created some very discreet projects for myself.

I love pixel art, classic 2D or 3D doesn't really appeal to me. The process of drawing and animation is like working with a mosaic, the most important thing is to arrange the squares in the right order, add a little chaos, and the output ends up being a cool picture or animation. To work with all this, I am inspired by my beloved wife Katerina.

Anvil Saga is my craziest project – in a good way. It's hard to find such fun, tons of references, and humor wrapped up in the harsh everyday life of a young blacksmith. It's because of this craziness that I am grateful for the game and our team. A special thanks to our producer, Daniil, because without him, this fun would be out of control.

And to you, dear players, I want to wish you a happy New Year. And most importantly – good pixel games. ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/5eb68073f2bb8fd1d7611cef017a52d58df55ed6.png[/img]

[h3][b]Peter, the narrative designer of Anvil Saga.[/b][/h3]

Anvil Saga was my first gameplay project, for which I am very grateful! I enjoy creating and designing characters and events, and really hope they bring you enjoyable emotions. Blacksmith Arthur and his friends (as well as enemies) are already like family, and I'm always excited to create new quests. 

My work is inspired by cool games, of which there are more every year. I believe the gaming industry has an incredible future, and I'm excited to be a small part of it. 

To all the players of Anvil Saga, I wish you a great New Year! May the customers pay the blacksmith generously in 2023, may there always be enough materials, and may the French finally make peace with the English! Happy holidays to all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/1d65040ed67d817009335e18ef573cd8cd4730e1.png[/img]

[h3][b]Daniil, producer on the HeroCraft PC side and game designer.[/b][/h3]

I started my journey in game development as a marketing manager, but I quickly realized that I was more interested in the development process itself, so I first moved into project management, and then into production.

What I love most about my work is to see how ideas are implemented into real content and mechanics, and how they form a complete game. I don't like routines. What inspires me to work is the path from the beginning to the final result. I love comparing the early versions to the final. I can't help but be motivated by the way projects change from prototype to final game.

Anvil Saga is like my adopted child. The lovely visual style, witty dialogues, and gameplay that allows you to to vibe and relax – at the same time, it requires concentration and decision-making. When I worked on Anvil Saga, I wanted to make the game to please me as a player first, not as a producer. I hope that it pleases you as well.

I wish our players that their forges grow and develop, and their provinces experience not a hundred years of war, but rather a thousand years of prosperity.

Our team is small but very friendly and hardworking. We love Anvil Saga and strive to make the game as original and exciting as possible, so that you will love it even more. 

Stay in touch with us here and on [url=https://discord.gg/XVMJFp4nsP]Discord[/url]. We love the Anvil Saga community and always read your thoughts and suggestions about the game.  

Regards,
Anvil Saga Team

notes.content:
Greetings to all the gifted blacksmiths!

Do you want to help create the world of Anvil Saga and get your name in the credits? Then we've got some cool as steel news to share with you.

So what do you need to do? Well, just think of a character that would visit Arthur with a request for an unusual order.

[*] And a description of the order. What is the item that the character orders and which parts are needed to create it.
[/list]

The Anvil Saga team will choose the most elaborate, fun, and original ideas as winners.

And you can enter as many times as you want to! Feel free to submit 1, 10, or 500 different characters!

[h3][b]How to submit your character:[/b][/h3]
Post your ideas on Steam under this post. Additionally, you can post a description of your character on Twitter, TikTok, or Instagram with the hashtag #AnvilSagaHeroes

notes.title: New in-game interface! Can you spot the difference?
notes.content:
Greetings! 

We have been improving the interface in Anvil Saga. It might sound like something small, but it's a pretty important part of game development and creating the best smithy sim for you!

Here's what we've changed:
[list]
[*] Added a brand new tool interface.
[*] Switched around the game speed and day counter.
[*] Changed the resource and reputation windows.
[/list]
We also added an [b]order feed[/b], which makes it much easier to manage the orders for your forge.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/977dbe_dc0d0cb6eb8a438cbf455166cb12441a~mv2.gif[/img]

The order feed contains all of the requests that you have accepted, whether they're regular, bulk, complex, or quest-related. To keep things organized, you can easily change the priority of every order, each of which will also have a count-down timer.

The order feed will come in handy when you need to complete orders that progress the story along with the regular ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/5c8a616093259d328dfdd0348f57b9dbd51475f8.png[/img]

[b]Regular orders[/b] are displayed as cards containing:
[list]
[*] An icon with the customer's face.
[*] The resources required to complete the order.
[*] Time remaining to complete the order.
[*] An image of the item.
[/list]
[b]The bulk orders[/b] are separated by item and include a counter for the number of items already completed.

For [b]Complex orders[/b] the cards are divided by order parts. Once you have created all the required parts, a new order for assembling the item will appear. Once the assembly is complete, the order is considered completed too.

And in addition to the interface design, we continue to populate the world of Anvil Saga with new characters. Here's another potential assistant to Arthur.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/063e69151935fc5b37fad97a249f6f8038f393c3.jpg[/img]

We can't wait for you to try out all of the new changes in Anvil Saga! Add the game to your Steam Wishlist today and don't forget to share it with all of your friends.

And, of course, you are more than welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/hks3eu8etY]Discord[/url]. All of the news we post will appear on Discord before going anywhere else.

notes.title: Something new every day
notes.content:
Greetings!

Running a business is never easy, especially during times of war. Despite the profitability of blacksmithing, your income and success will depend not only on your forging skills, but also your ability to adapt to any circumstance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40267025/cd4862c961d789d0b89bb0965b781fc0d94aef9c.png[/img]

Each new day may be different from the previous one thanks to the event system. Life in the village goes on as usual, seasons change, armies raise and lower new flags, and Arthur continues to fan fires and forge yet another order. Here are just some of the events that may occur throughout your gameplay session:

[list]
[*] Holidays. As part of the preparation for the festivities, tents are set up, fences are fixed and decorations installed. While this sounds fun, it also means that wood has rapidly increased in price. If you really need to restock your supplies, prepare to fork out. Fortunately (or unfortunately, depending on the relationships you’ve established), if the holiday event is associated with any of the game’s factions, their representatives will come to your shop more often. 

[*] Sowing and harvesting. Peasants everywhere! They come in pairs and will usually pay for their order with vegetables, but they may be willing to part with coin for the right tools. 

[*] Floods, forest fires, rainstorms - each one affects your life and your business in a different way. If the roads are washed out, for example, most of the customers simply will not be able to reach you. 
[/list]

All this, along with local clashes, celebrations, large construction projects and more, will make Arthur's life incredibly diverse and...interesting. Each event has a variety of consequences, both positive and negative. The ability to adapt and take advantage of any situation is what distinguishes a real businessman. Good luck in this difficult endeavor!

Respectfully,
The Anvil Saga Team
